title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for E_K in terms of the rest masses.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the application of energy conservation in the reaction.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply momentum conservation principles to relate the momenta of the particles.

title: Correct Substitutions
description: Important Criteria: The student should make appropriate substitutions for energies and momenta in the equations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy and momentum equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms are consistent in units throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to validate their solution.
